g.text: Series resistors share current; parallel resistors share voltage

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Series means the intermediate junction has no additional branch; parallel means every component shares the same two nodes. These topology conditions,
rather than visual proximity, justify the formulas.
